g.text: 1. Function: the HAT USB port on the board end of the flat cable (RFC 0015): USB 3 Gen 1, USB 2,

g.desc: 1. Function: the HAT USB port on the board end of the flat cable (RFC 0015): USB 3 Gen 1, USB 2,

g.text: CC and VBUS to the device-side piece and its pogo field (hats standard/ interface v2).

g.desc: CC and VBUS to the device-side piece and its pogo field (hats standard/ interface v2).

g.text: 2. Absent state: HAT or cable absent: no attach; the AC caps keep a dangling cable off the TX pair.

g.desc: 2. Absent state: HAT or cable absent: no attach; the AC caps keep a dangling cable off the TX pair.

g.text: 3. Contacts per interface v2 §9.2: VBUS on 3-31 odd, GND on 4-32 even, 33, 39, 42, 45, 48;

g.desc: 3. Contacts per interface v2 §9.2: VBUS on 3-31 odd, GND on 4-32 even, 33, 39, 42, 45, 48;

g.text: Contact numbering against the Hirose drawing is UNVERIFIED (interface v2 §11 item 5).

g.desc: Contact numbering against the Hirose drawing is UNVERIFIED (interface v2 §11 item 5).

g.text: 4. ESD and the VBUS TVS are on the device-side piece, none repeated here (BOM lines 65, 68, 69).

g.desc: 4. ESD and the VBUS TVS are on the device-side piece, none repeated here (BOM lines 65, 68, 69).

g.text: USB 3 TX AC coupling, USB 2 series (lines 70; HDG p. 59)

g.desc: USB 3 TX AC coupling, USB 2 series (lines 70; HDG p. 59)
